name: Find a case on the case list by region and open it (signed in)
description: Validates the case list: cases grouped under their region headings, each with its map sketch and how its track is known, and a card opens the replay.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-console-02+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Assert the page heading reads "Cases" and the list (data-testid case-list) has region headings "Gulf of Finland", "Central Baltic", "Norway and Svalbard", "Taiwan Strait" and "Red Sea"

Assert the Gulf of Finland group (data-testid case-region-gulf-of-finland) holds the card case-card-eagle-s-2024, whose text includes "Reconstructed from statements", and the Central Baltic group (data-testid case-region-central-baltic) holds the card case-card-yi-peng-3-2024, whose text includes "Reconstructed, then AIS from 06:01 UTC"
Assert every case card in the list contains a map image (an svg with role img)
Click the Yi Peng 3 card (data-testid case-card-yi-peng-3-2024)
Assert the URL path is /cases/yi-peng-3-2024 and the case switcher button (data-testid case-switcher) reads "Yi Peng 3 anchor drag"
